name: encoding-reflection-interface-method-result
description: A call of a method of an interface type holds, at an interface-typed result, what each method of a defined type of the program that implements that interface method returns there, a return statement whose one operand is a call of several results putting each result of the call at the same position, so a value an implementation returns as any reaches the destination the call's result reaches and keeps its exported fields. A value the program builds and no implementation returns keeps nothing.
